title: Suspicious file activity and file storage outage
description: Monitoring flagged unusual file activity on shared storage and uploads started failing. A SOC analyst suspects possible ransomware. Nothing has been confirmed.

backup-service.note: cannot take new file-storage snapshots; existing snapshots intact

timeline.description: Alert: abnormal file-access rate on file-storage
Health check failures on file-storage; incident opened

assumptions: Isolation cuts all network paths to and from file-storage in the simulation.
Isolation preserves the current storage contents for later forensic review (scenario assumption).
tradeoffs: Does not restore uploads by itself.
Prevents any spread from the affected storage to connected services.

assumptions: The verified snapshot is restored onto clean virtual storage.
Restoration succeeds (scenario assumption, not measured).
Objects changed after the snapshot are lost.
tradeoffs: Restores full service.
Restoring before the cause is understood or access is contained risks the same activity repeating.
May overwrite evidence needed for forensics if done in place.

assumptions: A restart does not reverse renamed objects (scenario assumption).
The fault is in stored data, not in the service process.
tradeoffs: Fast and low effort to attempt.
Likely to destroy volatile forensic state.
Does not remove the underlying cause.

assumptions: A simulated read-only replica built from the last verified snapshot serves traffic.
The replica is stale by the age of the snapshot, so it counts as degraded.
tradeoffs: Restores most functionality quickly.
Data written after the snapshot is not visible.
Leaves the affected storage untouched for investigation.

assumptions: No action is taken; the current simulated state persists.
tradeoffs: No operational risk from acting.
Leaves the outage and any ongoing activity unaddressed.

triage_hypotheses.statement: Ransomware-style malicious modification of file-storage objects
An authorized bulk batch or migration job is misbehaving
A storage infrastructure fault unrelated to security

title: Repeated failed logins followed by unusual successful login
description: Authentication monitoring flagged repeated failed logins for one user followed by a successful login from a new device. Analyst asked whether this warrants escalation.

timeline.description: Alert: repeated failed logins for m.ortiz
Successful login for m.ortiz from the same source after failures
Alert: login region differs from baseline

assumptions: No infrastructure change; the incident is handed to a human analyst for review.
tradeoffs: No collateral impact on users.
If the account is in fact compromised, access continues until a human acts.

assumptions: Isolating the admin portal blocks the suspicious session from admin functions.
tradeoffs: Limits potential admin-level exposure.
Admins lose portal access for all users, not just this one.

assumptions: Isolating the authentication service stops all logins.
tradeoffs: Stops all new authentication.
Takes down every service that requires authentication.

assumptions: A restart does not terminate sessions of a specific user or change account state (scenario assumption).
tradeoffs: Briefly disrupts authentication.
Does not address the account activity.

triage_hypotheses.statement: Credential guessing followed by takeover of the m.ortiz account
The legitimate user is travelling and mistyped the password

title: Application API outage
description: Customers receive 503 errors from the API. Several services are alarming at once.

timeline.description: Host alert: WAL volume full on primary-database
Application API returns 503 on all requests

assumptions: Capacity is freed on the log volume and the database is brought back from its latest verified state.
Restoration succeeds (scenario assumption, not measured).
tradeoffs: Restores the full dependency chain.
Requires a human to confirm the data state before reopening writes.

assumptions: The log volume is still full after a restart, so the process exits again (scenario assumption).
tradeoffs: Quick to attempt.
Likely to fail again until capacity is freed.

assumptions: A simulated replica built from the 10:00Z snapshot takes over and is treated as stale (degraded).
tradeoffs: Restores service sooner than a full repair.
Writes after the snapshot are lost until reconciled.

assumptions: Restarting the API clears its connection pool; the API itself is not faulty.
tradeoffs: Does not address the unavailable database dependency.

assumptions: No action is taken.
tradeoffs: No operational risk from acting.
Outage continues.

triage_hypotheses.statement: A malicious traffic flood or exploitation attempt against the Application API
Failure of a shared dependency causing cascading impact
Independent failures of the API and gateway
